request.spec:
The remainder of a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, the latest
added on a tie (a member with no cut gets none; a pool with no non-zero cut gives it to the last
member with a share).

agent.result_text:
The leftover from rounding a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, and to the latest-added one on a tie. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The change is in the `cut` method in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/pool/PoolRepository.java`, and I updated its comment to match. Before, the leftover went to the member with the largest share. Nothing else needed changing: the screen shows the cuts the server works out.

How it now works:
- **Who counts:** members are compared on their cut after rounding and before the leftover is added. A member with a 0.00 cut is never picked.
- **When every cut is zero:** the leftover goes to the last member who could get a cut and has a share above zero.

**One reading to check:** the request says "the last member with a share", and I took that to mean a member who could get a cut. So a retired or held member, or one outside their dates, never gets the leftover even if they have a share. None of the tests force this case, so say if you meant any member with a share.
